disqualifiers: spent entire career in pure research without production deployment
ai experience only recent langchain wrappers under 12 months with no prior ml
senior engineer not written production code in last 18 months
entire career only at consulting firms
primary expertise computer vision speech robotics with no nlp ir exposure
experience_note: Range is a guideline. Strong signals outside the range still considered.
behavioral_signals_important: last login recency — inactive candidates are not actually available
recruiter response rate — low rate means unreachable
open to work flag — strong intent signal
keyword_trap_warning: The right answer is not find candidates whose skills section contains the most AI keywords. A candidate who has all the AI keywords listed as skills but whose title is Marketing Manager is not a fit.
